answer_1.quote: We introduce VERITAS, a pipeline for Vision-Priors Evaluation and Refinement through Integration of Tri-Expert Assessment with Shrinkage, that systematically upgrades multimodal SFT data through four tightly coupled components: (1) Vision-Prior Extraction employs RAM++  and  to convert images into structured tags and texts that are provided to all subsequent modules, effectively anchoring the critique on observable evidence. (2) Tri-Expert Assessment queries three state-of-the-art LMMs (GPT-4o, Gemini-2.5-Pro , Doubao-1.5-pro ) for chain-of-thought critiques and numeric scores. ... (4) Self-Refinement generates three revised answers conditioned on the vision priors, the expert rationales, and Ŝ.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates revised multimodal answers through a self-refinement process conditioned on vision priors, expert rationales, and fused scores, aiming to produce high-confidence, hallucination-free responses for instruction tuning.

answer_2.quote: We adopt six widely-used public benchmarks that cover perception, reasoning, and hallucination: • MME : 14 binary diagnostics for basic perception. • OCR-VQA : text-in-image understanding. • MM-Vet : open-ended evaluation across 16 capabilities. • MathVista : visual-symbolic mathematical reasoning. • MMT-bench : 32 meta-tasks including autonomous driving. • POPE : hallucination detection.

Each expert receives the same vision priors extracted in Stage 1, ensuring grounded assessments.

answer_4.quote: Three human annotators independently assign an integer quality score from 0 (worst) to 5 (best); majority vote is taken as the reference label.
